rationale: The Court is most likely to affirm on a narrow Smith neutrality/general-applicability ground, emphasizing the categorical attendance rule and rejecting a constitutional opt-out absent targeting, hostility, discretionary exemptions, or compelled affirmation. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas (coercion/Yoder-based dissent) and Kavanaugh (Fulton/limited-opt-out dissent), with some chance of concurrences (especially Barrett/Kagan/Alito/Gorsuch) to cabin the holding and reserve harder cases.
